node.statement: Equations (1.3)-(1.5), evaluated after node 1.2.2, give positive finite C_N,C_R,C_L,C_Upsilon', then rho_Upsilon'>0 because its six entries are positive (including (2*C_R)^(-1)); next C_Upsilon>0 finite and rho_Upsilon>0 because its entries are positive (including [2*(C_T+C_Upsilon')]^(-1)); finally rho_DeltaUpsilon, rho_mult, and rho_UpsilonDelta are positive as minima of positive radii.
